Method of Attack: Malicious code in setup.py executes automatically upon installation
Retrieves IOPlatformUUID and hashes it using SHA-256
Compares hash against a predefined list of 64 MAC UUID hashes
Attempts to access application_default_credentials.json and credentials.db in ~/.config/gcloud directory
Exfiltrates data via HTTPS POST requests to a remote server
Discoverer: Checkmarx Supply Chain Security solution research team
